name: House of Shinobi
source:
A few years have passed since the last Shinobi War ravaged your hometown. You find yourself in the shoes of the protagonist, living under the same roof as your Landlady and Roommate. The shinobi world has undergone a paradigm shift towards imperialistic ideals. How would you act if you were unexpectedly given a reason, or an excuse, to act as you see fit?
Carve your own path through a world ruled by violence and stained with blood.
House of Shinobi is ultimately a game of choices. Will you walk the valiant path to protect those you love? Or will you let yourself sink into an abyss of reciprocal hatred. The fate of the shinobi world rests in your hands.​
